statistics.statistic: mean over seeds of per-seed symbol decoding accuracy (4000 symbols per seed per w)

criterion_as_applied: SUCCESS iff mean acc_T(0.4) >= 0.9 AND acc_T(0)-acc_T(0.4) <= 0.05 AND acc_C(0)-acc_C(0.4) >= 0.3 AND acc_N(0)-acc_N(0.4) >= 0.3; FAILURE iff acc_T(0)-acc_T(0.4) > 0.1 OR (acc_N(0.4) >= 0.9 AND acc_N(0)-acc_N(0.4) <= 0.05). success=False, failure=True. PC detected iff both decoders mean >= 0.98 at w=0 (separate seeds). CHEAT detected iff success and not failure on injected values.

stupid_explanations_status.text: monotone warps preserve order so any order decoder is invariant
stupid_explanations_status.how: one symbol per cycle, so within-cycle order carries no slot information; the null twin keeps pulse order and timing identical yet its drop is 0.795 vs treatment 0.125

stupid_explanations_status.text: warps too weak to move symbols across slot boundaries
stupid_explanations_status.how: fraction of symbols whose elapsed time crosses a clock slot boundary at w=0.4: 0.287

stupid_explanations_status.text: adaptive-scale decoder overfits the warp family
stupid_explanations_status.how: only one warp family (piecewise-linear, slopes 1+w*U[-1,1]) was run

notes: Carrier-phase decoding with a co-warped carrier: accuracy 1.000 at w=0 and 0.875 at w=0.4. Clock-time decoder with oracle cycle onsets: 1.000 -> 0.713. Same carrier-phase decoder with the carrier left unwarped (null twin): 1.000 -> 0.204. Positive control (w=0, separate seeds) carrier 1.000, clock 1.000. Outcome NULL by the PREREG class rules applied in code. The run does not test other warp families or a non-oscillatory co-warped clock (the spec's alternative explanation).
